title: UniCode: Augmenting Evaluation for Code Reasoning

bias_targets.methodology: Narrative perturbation augmentations that modify variable names, thematic backgrounds, or inject irrelevant contextual noise to determine if models rely on statistical shortcuts/surface-level tokens rather than reasoning.
Cross-evaluating models on problem sets generated by different source models (e.g., o4-mini vs. DeepSeek-r1) to check for self-preference or performance advantages on self-generated content.
